title: Adopt OpenAI's Responses API for chat calls
summary: OpenAI now recommends the Responses API over Chat Completions for all new work: better results from reasoning models, lower cost through better cache use, and built-in tools and state. Chat Completions still works, so this is an upgrade you can take, not a fix you need.
migration:
Move chat calls from Chat Completions to the Responses API, following OpenAI's migration guide.
1. The Responses API needs openai-node v4. If package.json has "openai" below 4.104.0, set it to "^4.104.0" and apply the v4 client changes first: `import OpenAI from "openai"`, `new OpenAI({ apiKey })` instead of `new OpenAIApi(new Configuration(...))`, and no `.data` wrapper on responses.
2. Replace `openai.chat.completions.create({ model, messages })` (or v3 `openai.createChatCompletion(...)`) with `openai.responses.create({ model, instructions, input })`.
3. Move any `{ role: "system" }` message into the top-level `instructions` string. Pass the remaining user/assistant messages as the `input` array (each item `{ role, content }` with string content); a single user message can be passed as a plain string.
4. Read the reply text from `response.output_text` instead of `choices[0].message.content`. Where code stores the assistant message for conversation history, store `{ role: "assistant", content: response.output_text }`.
5. Message types: use `OpenAI.Responses.ResponseInputItem` (or `{ role: "user" | "assistant"; content: string }`) instead of Chat Completions message types.
Keep model ids, prompts and every non-chat call (images, embeddings, audio) unchanged. Do not add tools, streaming or previous_response_id.
